title: Generalized ModMax and the Early Universe
summary: In this work, we study a cosmological model driven by Generalized ModMax nonlinear electrodynamics. We find that, with an appropriate choice of the theory's parameters, the universe's initial singularity can be avoided. Moreover, we also find that this model has an inflationary epoch that is consistent with the current values for $N$, $n_s$ and $r$. Therefore, using Generalized ModMax, we can construct a non singular Universe with an inflationary epoch.
